title: Morning at the Café
summary: Your first morning in the city. Mia runs the Corner Café next to your building. Order breakfast and chat about the neighbourhood.
npc_opening: Good morning and welcome to the Corner Café! I haven't seen you before. What can I get you today?

objectives.description: Order a drink or something to eat.
Answer Mia's question about how you like your order.
Say where you live or where something is, for example next to the park.

decision_points.prompt: The kitchen timer rings. Mia asks you to keep an eye on her blue backpack behind the counter for a few minutes.

options.label: Say yes and watch the backpack until Mia comes back.
Say sorry, you are in a hurry.
